name: Dense Rime
description: Pack frost so tightly round the knuckles that the punch lands with the weight of a stone.

name: Settled Palm
description: Set the weight of the whole body behind a frozen palm that sinks through the guard.

name: Rooted Rime
description: Sink the stance and let dense frost on the forearms take a heavy blow without giving ground.

name: Press Frost
description: Pin an opponent's weapon arm under a palm of dense cold until the grip loosens.

name: Slow Hail
description: Open the hand late in the throw so a heavy lump of hail lands at the end of the arc.

name: Crushing Cold
description: Drive a dense frozen palm through a raised guard and let the packed ice burst inside the arm.

name: Weighted Chill
description: Whip a lash of ice that carries the weight of an iron chain and drives the target low.

name: Settled Ice
description: Stand in a planted guard with dense ice held at the chest and arms through a long exchange.

name: Leaden Frost
description: Bring down a frozen fist with the full weight of the body and packed ice to split a shield rim or a heavy plank.

name: Sinking Cold
description: Press dense cold into the ground so it rolls outward beneath the feet of nearby opponents and holds them low.

name: Floor Spike
description: Call a short spike of ice up from the ground beneath the target's lead foot.

name: Spike Seed
description: Plant a seed of frost in the ground to draw on again in the next breath.

name: Rising Sleet
description: Lift a column of sleet that climbs and cuts the face and hands of the target.

name: Low Spike
description: Raise a low spike between the user and a charging foe to turn the charge aside.

name: Spike Row
description: Raise a straight row of ice spikes across the ground to rake everything standing in a line.

name: Ring Spikes
description: Raise a ring of spikes round one opponent that hems the legs and pins them where they stand.

name: Spike Lift
description: Heave a spike up under a heavy stance to throw the footing and lift the opponent off balance.

name: Great Spike
description: Drive one tall spear of ice up from the ground through the guard and armour of a single target.

name: Spike Bloom
description: Let spikes bloom outward in rings and hold a group of opponents in place among the rising thicket.

name: Rime Sense
description: Spread a faint field of cold round the body that registers any warm thing that enters it.

name: Rim Guard
description: Thicken the field at its edge so that arriving blows meet frost before they meet skin.

name: Rime Nip
description: Close the edge of the field on an arm that has strayed inside and bite it with cold.

name: Bleed Cold
description: Let the field draw warmth from a near opponent so the limbs slow and the grip softens.

name: Frost Pulse
description: Push a pulse of cold out of the field in one direction to sting a single distant target.

name: Rime Brand
description: Strike anything that touches the field with a cold that brands deep and stays in the flesh.

name: Cold Dome
description: Close the field into a dome of frost that stops arrows and light qi arts alike.

name: Toxin Chill
description: Pull a numbing cold through the field to chill a toxin in an ally standing inside it and draw it out.

name: Rime Collapse
description: Collapse the whole field inward in one burst that freezes the legs of everyone inside it.

name: Living Frost
description: Let the field answer on its own: it hardens where a blow lands and warns of the next approach.

name: Twin Frost
description: Strike with both palms as a matched pair so one blow opens the guard and the second lands.

name: Paired Glaze
description: Glaze the ground under both of an opponent's feet in the same moment.

name: Mirror Rime
description: Hold two frost-coated forearms crossed to turn a heavy blow to either side.

name: Even Cold
description: Run the same measure of cold through both hands so that they match in strength.

name: Matched Lashes
description: Cast two ice lashes at once with one binding the arm and one striking the ribs.

name: Double Screen
description: Raise two staggered screens of ice so a blow that breaks the first dies on the second.

name: Paired Spears
description: Thrust two spears of ice at one target from two angles so the guard can answer only one.

name: Pair Binding
description: Close a pair of frozen bands round both of an opponent's wrists and tighten them in step.

name: Hawk Frost
description: Drop from a raised step with a frozen hand like a stooping hawk and strike the shoulder.

name: Rime Wing
description: Spread both arms with a vane of rime along each to cover the sides and ward off cuts.

name: Updraft Chill
description: Ride a rising column of chilled air a short height to clear an obstacle or a low sweep.

name: Rimed Sight
description: Cool the eyes with a thin film of frost to sharpen distant sight and mark any movement.

name: Talon Chill
description: Hook the fingers into a claw coated in ice and rake it across an exposed gap.

name: Glide Ice
description: Slide along a long strip of ice on a low glide and arrive beside the target.

name: Stoop Strike
description: Fall on a target from above in a straight dive with an iced fist and rebound clear.

name: Pinion Sweep
description: Sweep both frost-edged arms outward to bat aside a cluster of blows and open the foe's centre.

name: Down Chill
description: Wrap an ally in a soft cold that draws out a fever or a taint as down draws off warmth.

name: Azure Rime
description: Throw a wide sheet of pale blue rime from both arms over a group and hem them in the cold.

name: Soaring Frost
description: Leap high and hurl a hard lance of ice downward then land clear of any answer.

name: Dual Chill
description: Run cold down two tracks of the body at once so the arms and legs hold the same frost.

name: Track Strike
description: Strike with the cold arm while the cold leg plants so that both carry the same blow.

name: Split Guard
description: Hold a frost guard on the left track and a counter on the right in the same breath.

name: Side Glide
description: Glide on a track of ice on one foot while the other foot turns to face the target.

name: Parallel Lance
description: Fire two parallel lances of ice from both arms in one movement at the head and the thigh.

name: Dual Freeze
description: Bind the arms with one stream of cold and the legs with the other until the target is held.

name: Steady Draw
description: Run one track of cold through an ally's wound while the other track keeps even pressure on it.

name: Double Lock
description: Close one freezing hand on a qi point of the opponent and the other on a second until both streams stop.

name: Both Tracks
description: Chain a strike and a guard and a step on the two tracks without a pause between them.

name: Sworn Frost
description: Swear to hold the cold steady and let the oath fix its weight in the palm.

name: Wind Chill
description: Throw frost on the breath so a bitter gust carries it into the face of the target.

name: Gust Ward
description: Turn a blow aside with a frozen sleeve while a gust lifts the user clear.

name: Draft Reading
description: Read the cold draught along a room's edge to learn which way a person is moving.

name: Bitter Gust
description: Roll a bitter freezing gust across the front to chill everyone it touches.

name: Sworn Hold
description: Hold an opponent in an oath-bound grip of frost that strength alone cannot pull free.

name: Frost Gale
description: Whip a wide gale of frost across a group so that cloth and skin stiffen as it passes.

name: Anchoring Gust
description: Pin the feet with ice and drive a freezing gust at the chest so the body must bend with nowhere to step.

name: Oath Cold
description: Speak the short oath of stillness and let the cold in the palm settle to a fixed even weight.

name: Open Chill
description: Strike with a bare open hand that hides nothing and carries a clean cold.

name: Naked Frost
description: Stand with no screen but a dense coat of frost on the body and take the blow openly.

name: Held Breath
description: Hold the breath and let cold roll off the body to still anyone close.

name: Sworn Slide
description: Slide forward on a straight line of ice without turning aside from the target.

name: Chilling Oath
description: Strike once for each breath of the oath and chill the target a little more each time.

name: Still Ward
description: Hold a frozen ward in the open that slows every blow aimed through it.

name: Frost Vow
description: Swear to hold a wounded ally steady and chill the wound closed while the oath lasts.

name: Unwavering Cold
description: Face a charge without a step and let the whole body harden into frost until the charge stops against it.

name: Sworn Lance
description: Drive a straight lance of ice along the line of sight to the target at the end of the oath.

name: Clear Frost
description: Throw a plain bolt of ice in clear sight along a clear line.

name: Bold Chill
description: Close with a cold fist thrown in plain sight and offer no feint.

name: Clear Ward
description: Hold a clear pane of ice before the body that shows the foe everything and stops everything.

name: Warmth Bearing
description: Take a bearing on a target's warmth and hold it through cold and dark.

name: Frost Lance
description: Cast one long line of ice along the held bearing through anything standing on it.

name: Open Pane
description: Turn a pane of ice at an angle to send a thrown blade or bolt back along the bearing.

name: Cold Reach
description: Extend a freezing arm along the line to still a distant opponent's weapon arm.

name: Unhidden Lance
description: Hurl a great lance of ice in plain sight that cannot be dodged by anything standing in its line.

name: Sticking Ice
description: Freeze a straight line across the ground that no foot can cross without sticking fast.
